name: confirm_brief
description: Confirm the choices from the rendered OpenDesign brief card. Returns a readable summary; draft ids and nonces are internal widget data, never user-facing copy.

answers.description: Question-id to selected stable option values.

briefDraftId.description: Internal draft id returned by collect_brief.

locale.description: BCP-47 Host locale used only when collect_brief had no request or tool-call locale.

pluginWorkflowId.description: Opaque workflow id issued by the local OpenDesign MCP after the first attributed call. Reuse it for later plugin-attributed calls; never invent or display it.
